subject: Gate 20: the owner's decisions on the four open items of gate20-requirements-draft.json / docs/stage6-freshvm/GATE20-REVIEW.md
owner_message: Direct human message in the Claude Code chat, 2026-10-04 (local): "accept all", in reply to Claude's message that listed the four items with a recommendation for each and asked for 'accept all' or the items to be decided differently. The owner did not state a different reading of the section 9(g) deadlines.

1: section 6(g) build and UBR not record.record: the VM settings saved at snapshot GATE18-PASS hold the Guest Additions property /VirtualBox/GuestInfo/OS/Release = 10.0.26300.9457 (vm\JARVIS-S6-FRESH.vbox.GATE18-PASS-copy); Windows Update paused until 2026-11-06 (Gate 17 C1-cleanliness).
1: section 6(g) build and UBR not record.stated_limitation: host-side evidence; the value was not read inside the guest during Gate 18.

2: section 9(g) deadlines and the v3 D9.decision: APPROVED_DISPOSITION. Bound set from the VM measurements: install, update and rollback each within 600 s; stopping a running JARVIS within 120 s. The four collector-harness deadlines (heartbeat 10 s, probe 13.6 s, retained-handle 15 s, cleanup 20 s) had no occasion to apply on this route, because the collector/observer harness did not run in Gates 16R-20.
2: section 9(g) deadlines and the v3 D9.measured: install 199.9 s (Gate 17) and about 208 s (Gate 18 K3); update 306.9 s; rollback 98.1 s; second update 165.8 s; stop 4.9 s, about 95 s (G5, G6); every measured run is inside the bound
2: section 9(g) deadlines and the v3 D9.note: 58bc2bcf Part 1: a finite bound from evidence, not an unlimited wait. The slow stops in the VM stay listed as a rough edge for the first release after cutover.

3: FINAL 1.0.11 hangs when a backup lies.decision: APPROVED_DISPOSITION: accepted as a known limitation of FINAL; no source change before cutover; to be fixed in the first release after cutover.

4: the test VM and the copies of the own.decision: KEEP for now: the VM (snapshot GATE18-PASS) and the personal-data copies (media\bcc2753f...zip, media\JARVIS-RECOVERY.iso, D:\JARVIS-release-work\stage6-media\JARVIS-RECOVERY.iso, D:\JARVIS-release-work\recovery-payload) stay under D: until the switch-over is done and has run well for a while; then they are deleted on the owner's word. Deleting the VM is the owner's act in VirtualBox (jarvis-s6-val).
4: the test VM and the copies of the own.conditions: the VM stays Stage 6 acceptance-only (AMENDMENT-v2 section 6(j)); its storage does not leave D:\JARVIS-S6-FRESHVM; no provider keys enter it.

effect: Items 1 to 3 are dispositioned, not passed. Item 4 is the owner's retention decision. Still outstanding for the verdict: checkpoint P5, only on the owner's own 'run P5'.
